notes: Element IDs read from the low-resolution inventory page; some digits are uncertain. Where an ID matched a catalogue entry (302001, 302301, 302201, 4211395, 4210633, 4211525, 4121715) I used it; the blue 2x4 brick (inventory 300123) was mapped to lego-3001 with colour=blue.
The booklet has two sub-builds: the sheep (book 1) and the brown/green base with rocks and plants (book 2); final page shows the sheep standing on the base.

Brick-to-brick attachments in many steps are inferred from small isometric drawings; the exact stud each part sits on is approximated, e.g. which of the white plates carries the tail handle piece (b19/b20/b21).
Head-to-body join (step 10) is modelled as the head's clip plate (b35) clipped onto the handle of the body plate (b20).

Each of the four legs has its Technic brick (lt) pushed onto a body pin (b5, b6, b10, b11) that is already seated in a tan Technic brick; leg feet are modelled as joined to the green 2x6 plates in the base since the final picture shows them standing on it (no explicit step).
Green flat pieces 4107762 (x3) modelled as 2x2 tiles; their exact size is uncertain.
Pin 4121715 is used in the catalogue as an axle connector; here its pin.1 end goes in the tan brick and its axle.1 end in the leg's pin-hole.
